sunnyf3.setting.enabled.tooltip: Draws the F3 screen in SunnyF3's sections. Off brings back the game's own text.
sunnyf3.setting.style.tooltip: Panels puts each section on a panel with its title. Strips puts each line on its own strip, as the game does. Bare is text with a shadow.
sunnyf3.setting.opacity.tooltip: How dark the panels or strips are, from clear (0) to solid (100).
sunnyf3.setting.headers.tooltip: Shows each section's title over its lines.
sunnyf3.setting.shadow.tooltip: Draws the text with a shadow. Bare style always has one.
sunnyf3.setting.colours.tooltip: Colours values by meaning: frame rate and server time green, yellow or red, light levels, memory, the X, Y and Z axes, and true or false block properties.
sunnyf3.setting.accent.tooltip: The colour of the section titles and the panels' edge.
sunnyf3.setting.refresh.tooltip: How often the text is made again. Higher is easier to read and costs less.
sunnyf3.setting.performance_place.toolti: Frame rate with its 1% low and frame time, the frame limit and VSync, the server's time a tick and TPS, packets.
sunnyf3.setting.performance_order.toolti: Lower numbers go higher up their column.
sunnyf3.setting.position_place.tooltip: Coordinates, block, chunk and the block inside it, facing, speed and dimension.
sunnyf3.setting.position_order.tooltip: Lower numbers go higher up their column.
sunnyf3.setting.world_place.tooltip: Biome, light at your feet (red where mobs can spawn), the day and the in-game time.
sunnyf3.setting.world_order.tooltip: Lower numbers go higher up their column.
sunnyf3.setting.target_place.tooltip: The block under the crosshair with its id, position and properties, and the creature you look at with its distance.
sunnyf3.setting.target_order.tooltip: Lower numbers go higher up their column.
sunnyf3.setting.system_place.tooltip: CPU, GPU, graphics API and driver, GPU load, memory and the window's size.
sunnyf3.setting.system_order.tooltip: Lower numbers go higher up their column.
sunnyf3.setting.sunrise_place.tooltip: Sunrise's version, mods running, sections and entities drawn, particles, shader pack and Sunrise GPU time, dynamic resolution, HDR and post effects.
sunnyf3.setting.sunrise_order.tooltip: Lower numbers go higher up their column.
sunnyf3.setting.entries_place.tooltip: Sunrise's own F3 lines as chosen on the F3+F6 screen, mods' entries included, as one more section.
sunnyf3.setting.entries_order.tooltip: Lower numbers go higher up their column.
